extracted.intended_audience: readers of Popular Science Monthly; general educated public and policymakers interested in late-19th-century US demography
extracted.subtask_description: A late-19th-century Popular Science Monthly essay analyzing U.S. census data (1790–1880) and discussing trends, causes, and implications of the increase and movement of the colored population. The piece interprets statistics, offers explanations, and draws social and political conclusions.
